newsitem.title: USA: Coventry to sell $40 mln notes, warrants.
newsitem.headline: Coventry to sell $40 mln notes, warrants.

text.p: Coventry Corp on Thursday said Warburg, Pincus Ventures LP and Franklin Capital Associates III LP agreed to buy $40 million of subordinated notes and warrants.
The notes are convertible into four million shares of Coventry common stock and exchangeable at the company's option into shares of convertible preferred stock.
The warrants are for the purchase of 2.35 million shares of common stock at $10.625 each.
Shares of Coventry, a managed health-care company, were trading at 11-3/4, up 3/16, early Thursday afternoon.
